Tuesday Evening Leisurely Ride

Tulsa, OK · River Parks · Road · Social

No-dropBeginner friendly

Tuesday Evening Leisurely Ride is a road and social group ride in Tulsa, OK. Schedule: Every Tuesday evening; start time shifts with the season, see club calendar, from River Parks parking lot, 68th & Riverside (overflow at Tom's Bicycles). About 15–20 miles, three groups: 8–11, 11–15, 15–18 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15–18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday Evening Leisurely Ride group ride

The club's easy weeknight ride along the river. Three pace groups from 8 to 18 mph, all no-drop and social, with regroup stops. Helmets required; lights required in fall and winter.
